q_en:
In this question, a statement is followed by two conclusions numbered I and II. You have to assume everything in the statement to be true and decide which of them logically follows beyond a reasonable doubt from the information given in the statement.

Statement: The boys team of school X lost 21 out of 30 basketball matches, but won 18 out of 24 cricket matches that they played this year.

Conclusions:
I. The boys team of school X likes cricket more than basketball.
II. The boys team of school X should start playing football instead of basketball.
